production.note: US model years. The owner gave 2009-2016 (owner decision, 8 October 2026), but the S started later: Edmunds' 2011 V8 Vantage page is the first to list 'S 2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 7AM)' (the 2009 page, edmunds-v8-vantage-2009, shows no S), and Evo calls it 'the Vantage S of 2011'. Cars.com groups the car as the '2011-2016 V8 Vantage S' (carscom-v8-vantage-s-years). Edmunds' 2016 page lists 'S 2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 6M)' (edmunds-v8-vantage-2016). The S Roadster is sold under its own name and is not part of this record.

aspiration.note: Inferred: 4.7-litre V8 with no turbocharger or supercharger mentioned.

fuel.note: Edmunds 2014 lists 'S 2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 6M)' and '(7AM)'; petrol V8 ('V8, gas' on Edmunds' V8 Vantage pages).

transmission.note: Edmunds 2014: 'S 2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 6M)' and 'S 2dr Coupe (4.7L 8cyl 7AM)'; 2016 the same (edmunds-v8-vantage-2016). 2011 and 2012 list only the 7AM (Sportshift II, an automated manual) (edmunds-v8-vantage-2011, edmunds-v8-vantage-2012). Cars.com 2014 lists '7-Speed A/T'.

powerHp.note: Quote (Evo specification panel, column 'V8 Vantage S (2011)'): "Power | 430bhp @ 7300rpm". Evo's figures are for the UK car; the US figure is the same: Cars.com 2014 2dr Cpe S, "Horsepower 430 hp" (carscom-v8-vantage-s-2014-coupe). Evo text: 'With its 4.7-litre engine generating 430bhp'.

weightLb.note: Step 2 of the weight order (major magazine specification panel; no Aston page with a weight could be opened). Quote (Evo specification panel, column 'V8 Vantage S (2011)'): "Weight | 1610kg". 1,610 kg x 2.20462 = 3,549.4, rounded to 3,549 lb. Evo prints a plain 'Weight' and marks no figure on the page as dry, so per the guide's 'Unlabelled weights' rule it is read as a kerb weight. Evo's figures are for the UK car; Cars.com confirms the US value: Cars.com 2014 2dr Cpe S, "Base Curb Weight 3,549 lbs" (carscom-v8-vantage-s-2014-coupe, 7-speed). The 2011 launch car had only the 7-speed Sportshift II; whether the later manual car weighs the same is not stated.
